name: design
description: Design-phase skills for TALXIS / Power Platform / Dataverse projects: reuse-first prototyping that models screens and custom UI components from proven industry patterns, existing TALXIS assets and the base-controls library, and turns user-story acceptance criteria into executable Gherkin feature files under the project's tests directory. Use when prototyping a screen or a custom control before implementation starts, or when authoring BDD tests from acceptance criteria and gating readiness on coverage. Produces design artifacts only — scaffolding, building, or running anything in the app workspace belongs to the implement plugin.
